support.p: Script: dbu can. According to [8H6M69W4]: blockprint (shing dpar), which is doubtful in view of the annotation "zhus te dag go" at the end, unless the blockprint reproduces this from a manuscript. Note in the left margin on the cover page: blo' dpal chen (possibly the name of the owner). The signature number (22 according to [8H6M69W4], No. 15403) is unclear on the reproduction. [S635TW6P]: 87 reports the signature "88." Annotations in dbu med (glosses) and dbu can (corrections).

chos rje sa skya paN Ti ta ni skyes ma thag pa'i rig pa rgyu dngos por med pa las skye ba ni yul dus nges par snang ba'i rtags kyis khegs la × | beMs po dbang po dang lus dang dbugs 'byung rngub sogs de dag tshgos pa las skye na | gang rung 1 ma tshang na rig pa mi skye bar 'gyur la × |
dang po ni kha 1pa tshab shes brjod gzhal bya las 'das pa'o zhes pa ni × |

yang rtsang nag don dam rnaM par dpyod pa'i blo skyes pa na × | dpyad bya don dam pa'i bden pa zhes pa ci yang ma rnyed pas der 'dzin pa'i blo zad pa la don dam bden pa rtogs so zhes tha snyad byas te × |
kha 1 gangs she dag du ma ni 1 yin par 'gal bas sbyor ba dang po 'thad la × | du ma la 1 yod par 'brel bas sbyor ba phyi ma 'thad do zhe'o ||

'ga' zhig dag daM bca' med par bshad pa ni yongs gcod sgrub pa'i daM bca' med par bshad pa yin 'dir ni rnam
gcad dgag pa'i daM bca' yin zhes pa dang 'ga' zhig pa tshab med ‹par› par bshad pa ni | de kho na nyid du yin la 'dir kun rdzob du daM bcas pa yin zhes pa ni × | kun rdzob tsaM du yang phyogs gzhan khas blangs pa med ces gsungs shing | daM bca' de dag la sgrub byed med na ni rgol ba'i gsog yin la |

kha cig rtsang nag rten 'brel
rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa nyid bden gnyis yin la ¦ de phan tshun dang so so la ltos te dbu ma yin te ¦ yod med kyi mtha' las grol ba'i phyir ces 'chad do ||

slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis
mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba'i bshad pa 'thad pa rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba ¦ lung dang rigs par smra ba'i dge slong shes rab 'buM gyis rnam grangs kyi bshad pa rnaMs re shig bzhag ste | slob dpon zla ba'i gzhung bzhin du || dpal brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'di re shig rdzogs s+ho || ||
